info.name: py-pg-notify
info.summary: py-pg-notify is a Python library that simplifies listening to and sending notifications using PostgreSQL's `LISTEN/NOTIFY` functionality. This package leverages `asyncpg` for asynchronous communication with the database, making it ideal for real-time applications
